t: Arrest By The Chinese Authorities Of Two Female Communists Deported From Hong Kong

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
v. D 2560
23/7/32

July 23 32.

My dear Steptoe,

With reference to my letter dated July 19,
1932, on the subject of two female Communists named
Chau Oi Ha(周愛霞) alias Au Mong Kok(區夢覺) and
Lau Tsung(劉貞) alias Mok King Ian(莫瓊蘭) who
were deported from Hongkong, information has now
been received to the effect that these prisoners were
handed over by the Public Safety Bureau to a represen-
tative of the Canton Police who, together with the
prisoners, left for Canton on the s.s. "King Yuen"
(廣元) on July 22.

Yours sincerely,

H. M. Steptoe, Esq.,
British Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
中央巡捕房登记处
卷宗号 D 2560
1932年7月23日

1932年7月23日。

亲爱的斯蒂普托（Steptoe）：

关于我1932年7月19日去信所述之事，即两名被从香港驱逐出境的女共产党员周愛霞（Chau Oi Ha），又名區夢覺（Au Mong Kok），以及劉貞（Lau Tsung），又名莫瓊蘭（Mok King Ian），现收到消息如下：上述囚犯已由公安局移交给一名广东警方代表，该代表与囚犯一同于7月22日乘“廣元”轮（s.s. "King Yuen"）前往广州。

此致

敬礼

H. M. Steptoe 先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C & S. B. REGISTRAR
No. D 3160
Date 19/7/32

July 29 32.

My dear Steptoe,

I have to inform you that two female Communists
named Chau Oi Ha(周愛霞) alias Au Mong Kok(區夢覺)
and Lau Tsum(刘貞 ) alias Mok King Lan(莫琼蘭),
deportees from Hongkong, arrived in Shanghai on board the
s.s. "Express of Asia" on July 17, 1932. Upon disembarking
at the Shanghai & Hongkew Wharf Co.'s Pootang Wharf,
they were immediately arrested by representatives of
Chinese Authorities who took them to the Public Safety
Bureau.

Yours sincerely,

N. N. Steptoe, Esq.,
British Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

编号 D 3160
日期 1932年7月19日

1932年7月29日。

亲爱的斯蒂普托（Steptoe）：

兹通知阁下，两名被从香港驱逐出境的女共产党员，名为周愛霞（Chau Oi Ha），又名區夢覺（Au Mong Kok），以及刘貞（Lau Tsum），又名莫琼蘭（Mok King Lan），于1932年7月17日乘“亚洲皇后”轮（s.s. "Express of Asia"）抵达上海。在浦东码头（Pootang Wharf，属上海虹口码头公司）下船时，她们立即被中国当局代表逮捕，并被带往公安局。

此致

敬礼

N. N. Steptoe 先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

Section 2, D.R. XXXX
Date July 18, 1932

Subject (in full) Arrest by the Chinese Authorities of two female communists
deported from Hongkong.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Everest

On July 16 information was received from H.B.M. Consulate-
General to the effect that two female communists named Chau Oi
Ha(周愛霞) alias Au Mong Kok(區夢覺) and Lau Tsun(刘貞 )
alias Mok King Lan(莫蘭) had been deported from Hongkong
on the s.s. "Empress of Asia" which was expected to arrive in
Shanghai on July 17.

The above information was passed to the Chinese
Authorities through Supt. Tan Shao-Liang and at 1 p.m. July 17
members of the local Bureau of Public Safety succeeded in
effecting the arrest of the two women as they disembarked from
the s.s. "Empress of Asia" at the Shanghai and Hongkew Wharf
Co.'s Pootung Wharf.

A memorandum regarding the antecedents of the arrested
persons is attached herewith.

D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称） 中国当局逮捕两名从香港驱逐出境的女共产党员。

制作人及转发人 分区副督察（D.S.I.）艾弗勒斯特（Everest）

7月16日，从英国驻华总领事馆收到消息，称两名女共产党员周愛霞（Chau Oi Ha），又名區夢覺（Au Mong Kok），以及刘貞（Lau Tsun），又名莫蘭（Mok King Lan），已被从香港驱逐出境，乘坐预计于7月17日抵达上海的“亚洲皇后”轮（s.s. "Empress of Asia"）。

上述信息已通过谭绍良（Tan Shao-Liang）巡官转交中国当局，7月17日下午1时，当地公安局成员在“亚洲皇后”轮停靠上海虹口码头公司浦东码头（Pootung Wharf）时，成功逮捕了这两名下船的妇女。

随函附上关于被捕人员背景的备忘录。

分区副督察（D. S. I.）

特别分部主管警官。

pages.en:
1. CHAU OI HA (周愛霞) alias AU MONG KOK (區夢覺)
alias CHAU YUK LAN(周若蘭 ) alias AU YIN (區媽 ),
27 years, teacher by profession, born in Sai Chiu
Village, of Nam Hoi, Kwangtung.
Joined the C. Y. movement in 1926 at Canton
and after six months in the training classes promoted
to the C.P. and elected on the Committee of the.
Women's Movement in Kwangtung.
Attended a Conference in Shanghai as the
Women's delegate in 1930, she returned to Hongkong
in September 1930 and took up the position of Women's
representative on the Two Kwong's Provincial Committee.
Since then she has plied her profession at
various girls schools in the Colony of Hongkong notably
the Yeuk Chi, To Sau and the Ling Tung schools and has
been engaged in spreading communism amongst the
students, she also held the position of Chief propagandist
in the Local Communist Party.

2. LAU TSUN(刘貞 ) alias MOK KING LAN(莫瑤蘭).
In 1930 was in charge of the Women's movement
in Kwongsai and was transferred to Hongkong about a
year ago and was a member of the Executive Committee of
the Municipal Committee and three months ago was
promoted to Chairman of the Municipal Committee. Our
informant claims that this woman is a Russian trained
Communist.
pages.zh:
1. 周愛霞（CHAU OI HA），又名區夢覺（AU MONG KOK），又名周若蘭（CHAU YUK LAN），又名區媽（AU YIN），27岁，职业教师，出生于广东南海西樵村。
1926年在广州加入共产主义青年团运动，经过六个月的训练班学习后晋升为共产党员，并当选为广东妇女运动委员会委员。
1930年作为妇女代表出席在上海召开的一次会议，她于1930年9月返回香港，担任两广省委妇女代表。
此后，她在香港殖民地的多所女子学校从事教职， notably 包括若智、陶秀及岭南等学校，并在学生中传播共产主义，她还担任当地共产党首席宣传员一职。

2. 刘貞（LAU TSUN），又名莫瑤蘭（MOK KING LAN）。
1930年负责广西的妇女运动，约一年前调至香港，曾任市委执行委员会委员，三个月前晋升为市委书记。我们的线人称，这名女子是一名受过俄国训练的共产党员。
